voices.advisor: Elderly British military advisor, warm and wise, slightly gravelly, calm measured delivery, reassuring
voices.varek: Old grizzled field marshal, very deep gravelly voice, slow, stoic and commanding
voices.ysolde: Stern aristocratic woman general in her forties, cold, crisp, precise and commanding
voices.quill: Portly sly quartermaster, nasal and amused, quick merchant patter
voices.oren: Young eager cavalry captain in his twenties, bright, boyish and overconfident
voices.hask: Huge bearded northern warlord, booming deep voice, rough accent, laughs easily
voices.imre: Calm sharp-witted woman tactician, low even voice, dry and understated

advisor.welcome: Welcome to the war table, Commander. The world is wide, the maps are blank, and every inch of it is ours for the taking.
advisor.deploy: Plant our flag and pour in the troops. Spread too thin and the vultures will pick us apart.
advisor.reinforce: Fresh regiments off the boats, Commander. Send them where the fighting is.
advisor.attack_hint: Select one of our lands, then click the enemy you mean to crush.
advisor.vacate_warn: Careful. March them all out and that land stands empty. Any jackal next door could stroll right in.
advisor.unplaced: We have regiments idling on the docks. Unplaced men go home, and I will not have it.
advisor.sealed: Orders sealed. Now we see who flinches.
advisor.reveal: There it is. Every army on the map, marching at once. Glorious.
advisor.walkin_us: A walk-in! They left the gates wide open and we marched straight through. Plant the flag!
advisor.walkin_them: Blast! They walked straight into a land we left empty.
advisor.hold: Our garrison held. Let them break their teeth on our walls.
advisor.lost_land: We have lost ground there, Commander. We will take it back with interest.
advisor.region: The whole region flies our colours. Its riches will swell our ranks every round.
advisor.cards: We hold a matching set of cards. Cash them in and call up the regiments.
advisor.final: Final round, Commander! Only land counts now. Throw in everything. Leave nothing in the barracks.
advisor.leader: We lead the war. Every crown at this table wants our head. Let them come.
advisor.behind: We are falling behind. Fortune favours the bold, Commander. Attack!
advisor.enemy_out: One less rival for the throne. Their lands are ripe for the taking.
advisor.defeat: We are beaten, Commander. Even empires fall. But what a war it was.
advisor.victory: Victory! The world bows to you, Commander. Magnificent. Utterly magnificent.
advisor.dug_in: Lands we hold dig in. Dug-in troops never march, so they keep a land safe while the rest go conquering.
advisor.surge: A clean breakthrough! With men to spare, we can surge on to the next land.
advisor.plan: Here is what I would do, Commander.
advisor.press: They are breaking! Press the attack!
advisor.retreat: Sound the retreat! Save the men for another day.
advisor.reserves: Send in the reserves! Every last man!
advisor.cut_off: We are cut off, Commander. There is no retreat. Fight or die.
advisor.opening_bad: A bloody opening. Fall back now and save the men, or press on and pray.
advisor.opening_good: A glorious opening! One more push and the land is ours.
advisor.maneuver: The dust has settled, Commander. March the men up to the front before the next assault.
advisor.melee: A melee, Commander! Every army piling in at once. Steady on every front!
advisor.draft_roll: Every commander throws a die. The highest roll claims first, and so on round the table.
advisor.draft_first: Fortune smiles, Commander. We choose first. Take the land that matters most.
advisor.draft_pick: Our pick, Commander. Claim a land.
advisor.cards_seized: Their war chest is ours, Commander. Every card they held now fights for us.
advisor.scramble: The defenders are finished. Now the victors turn on each other. Every man for himself!
advisor.cash_us: Cards turned in, Commander. Fresh regiments are marching to the front.
advisor.cash_them: They have turned in their cards. Expect a flood of fresh troops across the border.
advisor.orders: The troops are placed, Commander. Now, where do we strike?
advisor.surges: Now the breakthroughs. Every surge charges on at once!

varek.greet: Grand Marshal Varek. I have buried a hundred generals. You will be a hundred and one.
varek.lose: A setback. They will pay for it in blood.
varek.walkin: You left it empty. I merely accepted the invitation.
varek.eliminated: My war is over. Remember the old soldier.
varek.victory: The world is mine. It always was.
varek.retreat: Fall back. Regroup. We return at dawn.
varek.reserves: Bring up the reserves. End this.
varek.claim: This ground is mine. Dig in.
varek.cash: Fresh regiments. Send them to the front.

ysolde.greet: Viceroy Ysolde. Every land at this table will fly my banner. Guard your doors.
ysolde.lose: You will pay for that. Dearly.
ysolde.walkin: An empty fort is an insult to its owner. I have corrected it.
ysolde.eliminated: This is not the end of my house.
ysolde.reserves: Send everything. I do not lose.
ysolde.claim: I will take this one. Remember who chose first.
ysolde.cash: My reserves have arrived. Now you will see an army.

quill.greet: Governor Quill, of the Company. Everything has its price, and I intend to buy the world.
quill.attack: An investment opportunity, lads. Go and collect.
quill.eliminated: Bankrupt. Well, it was lovely doing business.
quill.victory: Tally it up. The Company owns the lot.
quill.retreat: Cut our losses, lads. Back to the ships.
quill.reserves: Double the investment! Send the reserves!
quill.claim: A fine piece of property. I will take it.
quill.cash: A fine return on the investment. More men, at once!

oren.greet: Captain Oren of the Hussars! First war, but I have a very fast horse!
oren.lose: Wait, that was not supposed to happen!
oren.walkin: Nobody home? Do not mind if I do!
oren.eliminated: I will be back. With more horses.
oren.victory: I won? I won! Somebody tell my mother!
oren.claim: Ooh, that one! I call that one!
oren.cash: Reinforcements! Oh, this is going to be fun!

hask.greet: Commodore Hask, the Old Bear! Bring me your best, little general, and I will sink it!
hask.attack: Haaa! Break them! Burn their boats!
hask.eliminated: Bah! Pour me a drink. I am done.
hask.victory: The Bear rules land and sea! Ha ha ha!
hask.retreat: Back to the ships! I will be back for you!
hask.reserves: More! Send more! The Bear is hungry!
hask.claim: Ha! Plant my flag there, lads!
hask.cash: More lads for the Bear! Ha!

imre.greet: Admiral Imre. I have already read your plan.
imre.walkin: You moved. I did not. That was the whole trick.
imre.retreat: The odds have turned. We withdraw.
imre.claim: That one. You were about to take it, were you not?
imre.cash: I have been saving these. Now they matter.
